title: Preserve the credit-hold release guard (ACC-004) as a modern account service
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py with release_credit_hold(account) -> (account, audits) and a BusinessRuleViolation exception: only a Y->N release with CRED_LIMIT > 0 succeeds (emitting one CRED_HOLD_OFF audit keyed by ACCT_ID); zero, negative, or blank CRED_LIMIT raises E1004 with the legacy message; releasing an account not on hold is a vacuous no-op with no audit.
expected_behavior: Successful release flips only CRED_HOLD to N and audits exactly [{code: CRED_HOLD_OFF, entity_id: ACCT_ID}]; CRED_LIMIT of 0, -100, or blank raises BusinessRuleViolation with code E1004 and the legacy message; blank CRED_HOLD means not on hold; inputs are never mutated.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1, §2, §4).
security_expectations: No network or subprocess imports; the guard must not be bypassable by blank/missing CRED_LIMIT (coerces to 0 and is rejected).
failure_conditions: Releasing with zero/blank credit limit; auditing a vacuous release; dropping the legacy code E1004 or its message; mutating the input account; changing fields other than CRED_HOLD.
